verdict.rationale: CrewAI agents/tasks are configured via natural-language role/goal/backstory/task descriptions that LLMs interpret autonomously, giving an agentic feel, but the product itself is primarily operated through Python code, YAML config, and a CLI (crewai create/run/test) rather than a natural-language command interface for the end user. A no-code 'Crew Studio'/Visual Builder exists but is drag-and-drop/form-based, not NL commands.
